name: search_reports
description: Keyword search across research/reports/ files. Returns ranked matches with file path, snippet, and matched keywords. Use this to find existing recommendations before writing a new report.

query.description: One or more keywords to search for, space-separated. Case-insensitive. Each keyword is matched independently; results ranked by match count.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

examples.description: Find reports that discuss SkillNet integration recommendations

matches.snippet: Three features from SkillNet are worth adopting for Agent Knowledge Hub...
Recommendation 1: add a 5-dimension quality score to the AKH skill submission form...
